Training Requirements

Create and maintain location-specific training requirements. Every location inherits the normal HASC global role/program rules unless you add an override here. You can require additional training, mark a global course not required for a location, limit a rule to specific staff categories, and set local due/renewal timing. Completion history is never deleted or rewritten.

Separate from Auto-Assign: Training Requirements controls what staff at a location are required to have for compliance. Auto-Assign remains the previous online/video assignment tool and does not define the compliance requirement list.

Upload Calendars

Upload the official monthly HASC Training Department PDF. The LMS reads the sessions, keeps the seasonal/holiday artwork exactly as supplied, and turns the calendar into a functional registration calendar.

Supported calendars: any monthly HASC Training Department PDF with a recognizable month/year and Sunday-Saturday calendar grid. The importer learns the actual date-row and cell boundaries from each PDF instead of assuming one fixed template, so uneven columns, seasonal artwork, different row heights, split pages, and common course-name variations are supported. Seasonal and holiday pictures are not recreated or hard-coded; every uploaded page is retained as rendered artwork. Approval behavior: approving a detected calendar creates or updates normal Scheduled Sessions immediately, making future sessions available in Register. Prototype persistence: calendar artwork and metadata are stored in this browser's IndexedDB until the production database/storage layer is connected.
1 · Upload the official PDF
Future months can be uploaded the same way; a revised PDF for an existing month updates that month's official calendar.

Staff Records & Import

Import the Empeon / Intelex staff export, or add staff in bulk by pasting rows. The roster currently holds {{ rosterCount }} staff. New staff start with all trainings "not taken".

Import staff file (.csv)
Optimized formats: Intelex Active Staff Export · Intelex Complete Staff Export · Empeon CSV

Upload either recurring Intelex export directly. The LMS automatically distinguishes the active-only roster from the complete active + inactive directory. The Flag column sets status: A = Active · I = Inactive/Archived · other / blank = Needs Review. New historical inactive employees from the complete directory are not added to the LMS, preventing unnecessary roster growth.

Local prototype: validation, roster changes, operational closeout, and rollback are applied as one browser transaction. The companion Supabase migration performs the authoritative production import in one database transaction with RLS and audit logging.
Recommended recurring import: the Intelex Active Staff Export. The LMS compares Employee Number against the current roster, updates only LMS-needed fields, and treats staff missing from the source as review-only unless you explicitly enable Full roster sync below.

Position fallback rule: when PositionTitle is blank and the staff member does not already have a non-placeholder title in the LMS, the import assigns DSP as a placeholder position and DSP training-role bucket. A later import containing the employee's actual title automatically replaces the DSP placeholder.
Supervisor fallback rule: when an active staff row has a blank SupervisorNumber or the imported supervisor is inactive / no longer present in the active roster, the LMS assigns a program/location leadership placeholder supervisor. Residential locations use the Area Coordinator first; if no Area Coordinator can be resolved, they fall back to Frumie Ziskind (Residential Coordinator). Self-Directed / Fiscal Intermediary programs fall back to the Director of FI Services when available. Day Hab programs fall back to Hadassah Halberthal, except New Jersey Day Hab, which falls back to Surie/Sarah Englard (Director of Day Services) while she is active in the current staff import; if she is no longer active/present, New Jersey Day Hab falls back to Hadassah. A later import with a real SupervisorNumber automatically replaces any placeholder.

Auto-Assign

Rules that hand out courses on their own. Match by role family or exact title, optionally limit the rule to one or more locations, and assign the required courses automatically when roster data changes. Nobody has to remember.

Match on role family, not one exact title
Your roster spells the same job five ways — Direct Support Professionals (2,156), DSP with AMAP (130), DSP AMAP and Driver (58), DSP Driver (24) and DSP (3). A rule pinned to one of those strings would quietly miss 215 DSPs. The DSP family means any title with DSP in it — including spellings Empeon hasn't produced yet, like DSPs, DSP2 or Lead DSP — plus the spelled-out Direct Support titles. It is the one definition the compliance engine, the reports, the Empeon importer and these rules all share, so a rule can't disagree with the requirement it's meant to satisfy. Exact titles are still there when you need them — the editor warns you if a pick leaves siblings behind.
In this prototype rules run in the browser when an import is applied. In production this belongs in a database trigger, so a rule fires whether or not an admin is looking.

Video Training

HASC's end-to-end training path: your course logic, your questions, your evidence, with Bunny Stream available for secure encoding and delivery. Assign by location, staff watch, answer questions embedded at timestamps inside the video, then take the end-of-video quiz — passing can post directly to the transcript, certificate history, and compliance record.

Bunny delivery with HASC-controlled completion evidence
Bunny Stream handles video upload, transcoding, adaptive playback, and delivery. The HASC LMS keeps ownership of assignments, timestamped questions, quiz attempts, attestations, certificates, transcript entries, and compliance rules. Bunny player events feed the same watched-second coverage engine used by hosted files: jumps are not credited, rewatching is not double-counted, and required in-video questions still interrupt playback.
Easy standalone setup: connect this LMS directly to Bunny Stream with your Library ID and Stream API key — no Cloudflare Worker or separate server is required. The key is kept in this browser only. On a shared computer, leave “Remember API key” turned off. Browser-side watch evidence should still be revalidated server-side before a completion is trusted. Certificate Eligibility by Course

Every valid completion for a configured course in this catalog is recorded on the staff transcript and generates a Certificate of Completion. Import-only / historical codes that are not in this course catalog remain transcript records and do not generate certificates. Most courses use the generic Certificate of Completion template; specialized courses (CPR, First Aid, SCIP, AMAP, Defensive Driving, Wheelchair Securement) use their own. Visibility controls who can see each certificate (staff / manager / admin-only; e.g. AMAP Pouring stays manager/admin only). Disabling a certificate is reserved for rare internal/system exceptions. Changes are audit-logged and apply to future completions. {{ certCfgIssued }} of {{ certCfgTotal }} courses currently issue a certificate.
